The call for submissions for the Real-Time Shading Symposium 2027, February 11-12 at Howest in Kortrijk, Belgium, is open until October 25th. 

Seeking talks on shading languages, neural graphics, production workflows, debugging and profiling tools, portability, etc.... Submitting is simple: send a short talk proposal through the online form. New speakers are welcome, and talks may build on previous work as long as they include updates or enhancements.
